findings.title: Board outline (Edge.Cuts)
findings.message: There is no board outline on the Edge.Cuts layer. The fab cannot cut the board.
findings.fix: Draw one closed outline on Edge.Cuts (a rectangle with rounded corners is fine).

findings.title: Annular rings
findings.message: 5 hole(s) have a copper ring thinner than the fab minimum (vias 0.13 mm, component pads 0.25 mm). The drill can break out of the pad.
findings.fix: Make the pad bigger or the hole smaller. Vias: 0.6 mm pad for a 0.3 mm hole.

checks.title: Hot loop: input capacitor at the switches

findings.title: Hot loop: input capacitor at the switches
findings.message: No ceramic capacitor found between the input and ground. Electrolytic caps alone cannot supply the fast switching current; the switch node will ring.
findings.fix: Put 1-3 ceramic capacitors (e.g. 2.2-10 µF 100 V X7R) right at the switches, across input and ground.

checks.title: Gate driver close to the MOSFETs

findings.title: Gate driver close to the MOSFETs
findings.message: U3 pin 3 is 47 mm from the gate of Q2. A long gate loop slows switching and picks up noise.
findings.fix: Move the driver within about 15 mm of the MOSFET, and run the gate and its return (source) side by side.

locations.label: Q2 gate

findings.title: Gate driver close to the MOSFETs
findings.message: U3 pin 8 is 53 mm from the gate of Q3. A long gate loop slows switching and picks up noise.
findings.fix: Move the driver within about 15 mm of the MOSFET, and run the gate and its return (source) side by side.

locations.label: Q3 gate

findings.title: Bootstrap capacitor at the driver
findings.message: Bootstrap capacitor C9 is 41.8 mm from U3 pin 2.
findings.fix: Place it right next to the driver's boot/HB and SW/HS pins, on the same side, without vias.

findings.title: Ground pour
findings.message: There is no ground copper pour. A switching converter needs a low-impedance ground (ideally a solid plane under the power stage).
findings.fix: Add a GND zone, at least on the bottom layer, and refill (B).

checks.title: Decoupling capacitors at IC supply pins

findings.title: Decoupling capacitors at IC supply pins
findings.message: U2 pin 1 (VI_1) has no small (<= 1 µF) capacitor to ground on +12V.
findings.fix: Add a 100 nF ceramic capacitor right at the pin, with its ground pad going straight to ground.

findings.title: Decoupling capacitors at IC supply pins
findings.message: U3 pin 1 (VDD_1) has no small (<= 1 µF) capacitor to ground on +12V.
findings.fix: Add a 100 nF ceramic capacitor right at the pin, with its ground pad going straight to ground.

checks.title: No open vias in SMD pads
Test points (EE463: verify supplies and gate signals)

findings.title: Test points (EE463: verify supplies and gate signals)
findings.message: The board has no test points. EE463 asks you to check the auxiliary supplies and gate signals before powering the power stage.
findings.fix: Add test points (or a small header) for ground, each auxiliary supply, each gate signal and the switch node.

findings.title: Test points (EE463: verify supplies and gate signals)
findings.message: No test point on ground. Every probe needs a ground point nearby.
findings.fix: Add one or two GND test points (a loop or hook type is easiest for scope probes).

findings.title: Test points (EE463: verify supplies and gate signals)
findings.message: No test point on the gate signal of Q2 (Net-(D4-A) / Net-(U3-HO)).
findings.fix: Add a test point on the gate (or the driver output) so you can see the gate waveform.
